findings.summary: The verifier works out the newest leaf per reviewer only from the leaves listed in the envelope. A signer that leaves a newer rejected leaf out of the envelope would still verify. The old all-leaves check had the same gap, so this change doesn't make it worse, and it isn't blocking. A later hardening could cross-check against every on-disk leaf for the patch-id.

findings.summary: The verifier finds each reviewer's newest leaf only among the leaves listed in envelope.transcriptLeaves, not among every leaf on disk for the patch-id. This gap existed before this change and is not made worse. Suggested follow-up: require every non-plan/execute on-disk leaf for the patch-id to appear in transcriptLeaves, or work out the newest leaf from onDiskLeaves directly.
